source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    src = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(value for row in src for value in row if value != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(src) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    max_r = max(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in points)
    mask = {(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points}
    height, width = len(src), len(src[0])
    mask_height, mask_width = max_r - min_r + 1, max_c - min_c + 1

    for top in range(height - mask_height + 1):
        for left in range(width - mask_width + 1):
            if all(src[top + dr][left + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in mask):
                for dr, dc in mask:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = color
    return out
'''
